title: PC E101: General
officialText:
E101.1 Scope.

E101.1.1

This appendix outlines the procedure that may be utilized for sizing a water piping system (see Section E103.3). The design procedure is based on the minimum static pressure available from the supply source, the head changes in the system caused by friction and elevation, and the rates of flow necessary for operation of various fixtures.
